mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE crosses above 7.5%, rising unemployment signals weak labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE stays below 7.5 or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (quarterly demand) and HOUST (monthly labor demand) signals robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase by >5% in the same month
failure_condition: If the proxies don't both rise as expected, or returns aren't positive (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO, the monthly production index, indicates robust supply growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO doesn't rise significantly over the next 5 days, or returns aren't positive (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous rises in GDPC1 (demand) and UNRATE below 7.5% signal near-term peak, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases >2% and UNRATE <7.5% in the same month
failure_condition: If the regime isn't late-cycle, or conditions aren't met, or returns aren't positive (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL, the monthly inflation index, exceeds 235, signaling high inflation, this triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL doesn't cross above 235, or returns aren't negative (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary) and PAYEMS (monthly employment) suggests conflicting signals but strong labor demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and PAYEMS increase by >1% in the same month
failure_condition: If the proxies don't rise as expected, or returns aren't positive (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery context, simultaneous falls in FEDFUNDS (monetary) and UNRATE below 6.5% signal recovery momentum, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS <1% and UNRATE <6.5% in the same month
failure_condition: If the regime isn't post-shock, or conditions aren't met, or returns aren't positive (p > 0.05), the hypothesis is rejected.
